source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of Salvagers' Guild Neo-Ancient Pylon vestment cloth: crisp formwork-grey (#5c6066) and Ancient-white (#eeebe5) heavy cotton-polymer twill quilted and appliqued with repeating nested round-topped tombstone-arch and stadium-pill frames (four arches across, two rows down) edged with structural saffron-gold (#e3a02e) piping, bright Iziz-orange (#e07a2a) inner bevel reveals, and warm glowing amber (#ff8a24) triple-oculus Monolith bars, whole inside every seam. Full colour.
